subject: how to fine-tune scale_nominal associated with "x" or "y"?

messages.author: 912329a6ad1a6995
messages.subject: how to fine-tune scale_nominal associated with "x" or "y"?
parts:
Hello again,

I'm sure I am reaching my limit on questions :), so this might be a good time for my periodic expression of sincere appreciation for what the ggvis team is doing. 

Sorry that this example is perhaps not minimal.

My question here is that in my plot `gg_plus_rects`, the points have been shifted to the top of the `band()`, as compared with `gg_points_only`.

Is there a way to keep the points centered in the band?  I tried to fiddle with the `mult` and `offset` args to band(), without success.

Thanks (as always),

Ian

library(ggvis)

n_true <- 20
x_true <- rnorm(n_true, mean = 5, sd = 3)

n_false <- 20
x_false <- rnorm(n_false, mean = -5, sd = 3)

data_points <- data.frame(
  x = c(x_true, x_false),
  status = c(rep("TRUE", n_true), rep("FALSE", n_false))
)

data_rects <- data.frame(
  x = c(-15, -15, 0, 0),
  x2 = c(0, 0, 15, 15),
  status = c("FALSE", "FALSE", "TRUE", "TRUE"),
  status_y = c("TRUE", "FALSE", "TRUE", "FALSE")
)

gg_points_only <-
  data.frame() %>%
  ggvis() %>%
  layer_points(
    x = ~x, y = ~status, fill = ~status,
    data = data_points
  ) %>%
  scale_nominal("y", domain = c("TRUE", "FALSE")) %>%
  scale_nominal("fill", domain = c("TRUE", "FALSE")) 

gg_plus_rects <-
  data.frame() %>%
  ggvis() %>%
  layer_rects(
    x = ~x, x2 = ~x2, y = ~status_y, fill = ~status,
    height = band(), fillOpacity := 0.5, strokeWidth := 0,
    data = data_rects
  ) %>%
  layer_points(
    x = ~x, y = ~status, fill = ~status,
    data = data_points
  ) %>%
  scale_nominal("y", domain = c("TRUE", "FALSE"), padding = 0) %>%
  scale_nominal("fill", domain = c("TRUE", "FALSE")) 

gg_plus_rects
